If the parties fail to appoint sole arbitrator within sixty (60) days after receipt of a noti ce from the other party invoking arbitration, the appointment of sole arbitrator shall be done by Courts as per the provisions of Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 19

96 or any statutory modification thereof. Seat of Arbitration shall be at Bhubaneswar, Odisha. 18) JURISDICTION OF CONTRACT: The courts of Bhubaneswar shall have exclusive jurisdiction in all matters arising out of this contract including execution of arbitration awards as per POWERGRID norms. 19) M/s Siemens Energy India Limited has confirmed to place the award through GeM via GeM Seller ID-QEFM250013000319 .
